build_autoaugment_transform: build an AutoAugment transform with imagenet preset policies for image data augmentation
build_randaugment_transform: build a RandAugment transform with timm_increasing policies and configurable magnitude level
create_shear_transform: create a Shear transform to horizontally or vertically shear images with random magnitude
create_rotate_transform: create a Rotate transform to rotate images by a random angle with padding
create_solarize_transform: create a Solarize transform to invert pixel values above a random threshold
